methodology.criminal_actors_formula: simple average of available criminal-actor indicators
methodology.criminal_markets_formula: simple average of available criminal-market indicators
methodology.criminality_formula: simple average of criminal_markets and criminal_actors
methodology.score_origin: official expert-led scores from the workbook; GIR does not rescore countries
methodology.weighting: All elements within each component/subcomponent are evenly weighted; the publisher notes implicit weighting can remain because categories are separate.

license.patch_decision: bundle official workbook and normalized derivative with attribution; register pending legal review for downstream redistribution policy

score_scale.precision: official displayed values up to two decimals
score_scale.warning: Criminality and resilience are separate axes. GIR does not combine them into a synthetic score.
